local.notes: Spawns ephemeral local port; captures status/headers/body.

remote.notes: Requires CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN (or wrangler login). Ownership markers track cleanup.

preview.notes: Falls back to REMOTE_NOT_CONFIGURED / PREVIEW_NOT_AVAILABLE honestly.

commands.purpose: Real local compatibility-date matrix (no fabricated cells)
Live meeting demo: real local + optional preview

bindings.name: Workers HTTP fetch handler
bindings.notes: Primary parity surface: status, body, headers via wrangler dev --local vs remote/preview.

bindings.name: Plaintext vars
bindings.notes: HTTP-observable via /bindings/vars. Parity compares response bodies, not env dumps.

bindings.name: KV namespaces
bindings.notes: HTTP-observable KV get/put via /bindings/kv. Local simulator and remote namespace IDs supported.

bindings.name: D1 databases
bindings.notes: HTTP-observable D1 SELECT via /bindings/d1. Migrations applied locally; remote uses provisioned DB.

bindings.name: Durable Objects
bindings.notes: HTTP-observable DO fetch via /bindings/do (Counter DO). Interaction recorded on traces.

bindings.name: Queues (producers/consumers)
bindings.notes: HTTP enqueue via /bindings/queues; consumer writes deterministic KV marker for parity.

bindings.name: Service bindings
bindings.notes: HTTP-observable via /bindings/service calling Worker Entrypoint over service binding.

bindings.name: Workflows
bindings.notes: HTTP-observable workflow create/status via /bindings/workflows with deterministic step output.

bindings.name: Hyperdrive
bindings.notes: HTTP-observable via /bindings/hyperdrive. Uses Hyperdrive when configured; deterministic fixture fallback otherwise.

bindings.name: Vectorize
bindings.notes: HTTP-observable via /bindings/vectorize. Uses Vectorize when configured; deterministic fixture fallback otherwise.

bindings.name: Workers AI
bindings.notes: HTTP-observable via /bindings/ai. Model text is normalized before parity; structure compared STABLE.

bindings.name: WebSockets
bindings.notes: WebSocket upgrade at /bindings/ws; lifecycle messages captured and compared after normalization.

bindings.name: Cron Triggers
bindings.notes: scheduled() handler + /bindings/cron HTTP mirror share deterministic marker for parity.

honesty: EdgeMirror is not affiliated with Cloudflare, Inc.
Missing credentials yield REMOTE_NOT_CONFIGURED — never fabricated remote traces.
Compat/matrix cells are only written after real local executions.
Infrastructure failures are never classified as RUNTIME_DIVERGENCE.
DEMO / pitch findings are labeled and isolated from real project corpora.
Support levels describe EdgeMirror capability, not Cloudflare product GA status.

usesCloudflareProducts: Wrangler (dev, deploy, versions upload, delete, whoami)
workers.dev temporary Workers for remote parity
dogfood.notes: EdgeMirror orchestrates Wrangler; it does not replace Cloudflare tooling. Hosted EdgeMirror Cloud may later run on Workers where appropriate — not required for CLI correctness.
